probe.bodyPenetration: free cape vertices (rows 1-18) deeper than 0.01 m inside the posed physics-asset capsules the cloth collides with
probe.hairTip: ponytail_6 in the Head bone frame; offset from its spot at the end of settle (game.ts measureHair)
probe.hairStretch: largest |segment / rest - 1| over ponytail_1..6, rest on the Idle_Loop t = 0 pose
probe.hairInsideHead: ponytail_2..6 inside the stock capsules of Head, spine_03, spine_02, upperarm_l, upperarm_r plus 0.005 m (game.ts also has neck_01; Unreal generates no neck_01 body)

overrides.maxDistanceMask: 0 cm on the top row (11 pinned vertices), 1000 cm elsewhere: the painted mask the brief asks for (the factory creates it all 0)
overrides.collisionPhysicsAsset: the body-only import's generated physics asset (see assets.bodyPhysicsAsset), not the caped mesh's
overrides.visibilityBasedAnimTickOption: AlwaysTickPoseAndRefreshBones: nothing renders offscreen, so bones must refresh unrendered (harness, not a cloth parameter)
overrides.bWaitForParallelClothTask: true: GetCurrentClothingData_GameThread requires it (harness, read-out only)
overrides.capsuleRestClearance: every capsule radius = min(stock radius, distance to the nearest rest cape vertex - 1 cm) on the Idle_Loop t = 0 pose, dropped under 0.1 cm (game.ts: measureBodyCapsules(capeSkin, 16, restWorld, COLLIDER_THICKNESS)); applied in RunDrive, in memory, restored after the run

determinism: 3 separate simulations (a fresh world and fresh clothing actors per run, CharDynProbe RunDrive); Chaos Cloth at a fixed step is deterministic, so the run files are byte-identical and the spread is 0

differences.crossfade: the game's AnimationPlayer smoothstep crossfade is replayed by UCharDynAnimInstance; Unreal blends the poses with FAnimationRuntime::BlendPosesTogether (normalised quaternion blend) where three.js accumulates slerps, and samples the Interchange-resampled clips
differences.readback: Unreal reads the simulated positions every tick for the same tick's pose; the game reads a GPU readback every 2 frames and matches it to the pose of the step that produced it
differences.gravity: -9.80 m/s^2 in Unreal, -9.81 m/s^2 in the game

hair.node: FAnimNode_SpringBone, one per simulated bone (ponytail_2..6), parent first, each fed the previous node's pose, driven in UCharDynAnimInstance's proxy; ponytail_1 rides Head (SpringBoneChain3D's root)
hair.defaults: stock (UE 5.8.3: Engine/Source/Runtime/AnimGraphRuntime/Private/BoneControllers/AnimNode_SpringBone.cpp:16-38): SpringStiffness 50, SpringDamping 4, ErrorResetThresh 256 cm, bLimitDisplacement false, translate X/Y/Z on, rotate X/Y/Z off; fixed step 1/120 s (:62-63); no gravity, no collision
hair.differences: SpringBoneChain3D (game) keeps each segment at its rest length, rotates the bones toward the particles and pushes them out of the body capsules; the stock SpringBone translates the bone only, so segments stretch, and it has no collider. Its damping acts on the world velocity and OwnerVelocity is 0 for an actor's own component (AnimNode_SpringBone.cpp:139-157, 257-266), so each spring trails its target by damping * speed / stiffness (27 cm at 3.4 m/s) and the 5 springs add up. Teleport: SpringBone resets past 256 cm of error, SpringBoneChain3D past 1.5 m of root move or 1 m of error
hair.start: the springs are placed on the Idle_Loop t = 0 pose by a zero-length evaluation before tick 1 (InitAnim's zero tick, SkeletalMeshComponent.cpp:1213-1216; the game builds SpringBoneChain3D on that pose)

hairAnimDynamics.node: FAnimNode_AnimDynamics, bChain true, BoundBone ponytail_1, ChainEnd ponytail_6: one rigid body per bone, each joined to its parent at the segment midpoint (InitPhysics, AnimNode_AnimDynamics.cpp:1110-1121); ponytail_1's body is nailed to its animated position (bLinearFullyLocked, :1272-1277), so it rides Head and ponytail_2..6 hang from it. Evaluated in UCharDynAnimInstance's proxy on the animated pose, beside the SpringBone chain; the output is recorded, not applied
hairAnimDynamics.defaults: stock (UE 5.8.3: Engine/Source/Runtime/AnimGraphRuntime/Private/BoneControllers/AnimNode_AnimDynamics.cpp:190-246 and Public/BoneControllers/AnimNode_AnimDynamics.h:91-110, 241-248): one body definition copied to every chain bone (UpdateChainPhysicsBodyDefinitions, :831-866), BoxExtents 10 x 10 x 10 cm, LocalJointOffset 0, CollisionType CoM, linear X/Y/Z Limited 0..0 (locked), angular type Angular with limits 0..0 on X/Y/Z and twist axis X; GravityScale 1 (:195) with the project gravity -980 cm/s2 (PhysicsSettingsCore.cpp:29, AnimPhysicsSolver.cpp:875); linear and angular damping 0.7 (AnimPhysicsSolver.h:56-59), JointBiasFactor 0.3 (:53), mass 1 (AnimPhysicsSolver.cpp:159); NumSolverIterationsPreUpdate 4, PostUpdate 1 (:202-203); SimulationSpace Component (:205); ComponentLinearAccScale and ComponentLinearVelScale 0 (:238-239), SimSpaceAngularAlpha 0 (:183); no linear or angular spring (:219-220), no wind (:215), no planar or spherical limits (none listed; :208-209), so no collision; adaptive substepping off (p.AnimDynamicsAdaptiveSubstep 0, :26), so one step of the tick delta per tick, capped at MaxPhysicsDeltaTime 1/30 s (:691-701, PhysicsSettings.cpp:22)

arms.swing: named override: AngularLimitsMin/Max -180/+180 on X/Y/Z, the editor's range end (AnimNode_AnimDynamics.h:170-174). ConstrainAngularRange adds no swing limit for a range of 360 degrees (AnimPhysicsSolver.cpp:733-757); twist stays locked (:759-760). The stock 0..0 range locks each body to its parent (:733-736), a rigid chain
arms.swingWorld: swing plus the named override SimulationSpace World. Stock Component space passes no component motion to the bodies (ComponentLinearAccScale/VelScale 0, SimSpaceAngularAlpha 0, :600-646), so locomotion and turns do not reach the chain; World space keeps the bodies in the world, as SpringBoneChain3D does. On the first teleport tick the arms get ResetDynamics(TeleportPhysics), what a SetActorLocation with ETeleportType::TeleportPhysics does to an AnimGraph (SkeletalMeshComponent.cpp:5350-5354, AnimInstance.cpp:696-700); the cloth keeps its own teleport guard

hairAnimDynamics.boxExtents: stock 10 cm cube kept: with mass 1 per body it sets only the inertia, and it is the same order as the 7.8 cm segment; collision is off, so it touches nothing
hairAnimDynamics.start: Initialize_AnyThread on the Idle_Loop t = 0 pose before tick 1 (ResetSprings), so InitPhysics places every body on its bone with no time debt (AnimNode_AnimDynamics.cpp:248-268, 1002-1196)
hairAnimDynamics.restLengths: the SpringBone block's: segment lengths on the Idle_Loop t = 0 pose

hairSpringBoneRotate.node: FAnimNode_SpringBone, one per simulated bone (ponytail_2..6), parent first, as the stock chain above, with named option overrides per arm. Each arm runs on its own copy of the animated pose beside the stock chain; its output is recorded, not applied, so the cape and the stock chain do not change
hairSpringBoneRotate.why: SpringBoneChain3D keeps every segment at its rest length and turns the bones. The stock translate-only chain stretches to metres. These are the stock options that bear on that: rotation (bRotateX/Y/Z) and the displacement limit (bLimitDisplacement, MaxDisplacement)
hairSpringBoneRotate.notAnOption: translation off: with bTranslateX/Y/Z all false the node returns before it computes anything (AnimNode_SpringBone.cpp:102-105), so rotation alone moves nothing

arms.rotate: bRotateX/Y/Z true, everything else stock. The bone turns by the angle between parent-to-target and parent-to-spring (:206-221), and the next bone's target hangs off the turned bone
arms.limitHalf: bLimitDisplacement true, MaxDisplacement 3.9 cm (half the 7.81 cm rest segment): the bone stays within 3.9 cm of its target (:177-187), the only stock bound on the stretch
arms.limitFull: bLimitDisplacement true, MaxDisplacement 7.8 cm (one rest segment)

hairSpringBoneRotate.restLengths: the SpringBone block's: segment lengths on the Idle_Loop t = 0 pose

perturbation.why: Chaos Cloth, FAnimNode_SpringBone and FAnimNode_AnimDynamics are deterministic, so the 3-run spread of the blocks above is 0. A float-level change in the start state is what moves a chaotic system, so this block is the honest spread: the metric over the unperturbed run and 3 perturbed runs
perturbation.rule: run k (k = 1, 2, 3) starts every free cloth particle (all but the pinned top row, grid row 0) k * 0.0001 cm along its own fixed unit vector, FRandomStream(1000 + particle index).VRand(), by editing the cloth asset's physical-mesh vertices in memory before the clothing actors are made. It also starts ponytail_2..6 k * 0.0001 cm along FRandomStream(90000 + chain index 1..5).VRand() in component space, by moving them in the evaluation that places the chains, so the SpringBone chain, every SpringBone arm and every AnimDynamics arm start off their bones by the same amount. Nothing else changes: same script, same step, same rest lengths (the unperturbed run's)
perturbation.runs: [unperturbed, perturbed 1, perturbed 2, perturbed 3]; the unperturbed values equal the 3 identical runs of the blocks above
perturbation.command: pnpm exec tsx tools/unreal-reference/character-dynamics/reference.ts perturb (TN_UE_PERTURB=1,2,3), then metrics
